lean.statement: theorem ordinary_pullback_rightUnit (K : Scheme.{t}) (s : Option ℕ) : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (aX : X ⟶ K) (aY : Y ⟶ K) [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (_hf : f ≫ aY = aX) (M : Modules ell E Y s), (pull ell E f s).map ((identity ell E Y s).hom.app M) = (comp ell E f (𝟙 Y) s).hom.app M ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun a ↦ (pull ell E a s).obj M) (Category.comp_id f))
